work_package: S1-WP1 — Preserve workspaces and bind execution authority
ending_worktree_state: dirty; scoped WP1 implementation, tests, report and baton files are uncommitted; generated appshak_state output is ignored
objective: Make normal durable workspace startup non-destructive and require explicit attributable execution authority for every tool side effect.
root_cause: WorkspaceManager reset and cleaned existing worktrees during normal ensure_worktrees.
Tool requests had no required durable attribution contract tying authority, source, worker, workspace, operation and creation time.
implementation_summary: Normal workspace reuse validates registered Git worktrees and preserves dirty/untracked state.
Explicit reset remains available only through reset_on_ensure/--reset-worktrees.
ToolRequest carries authority_id, source_request_id, workspace_id, requested_operation and created_at.
ToolGateway rejects incomplete or mismatched authority and records valid attribution in tool audit payloads.
AgentRuntime propagates authority fields from durable request envelopes.
workspace_preservation_status: PASS — normal startup reuses valid registered worktrees and preserves dirty/untracked state; explicit reset is opt-in; invalid existing paths fail safely.
execution_authority_status: PASS_WITH_NONBLOCKING_FINDINGS — required fields are validated and persisted in tool audit, but dedicated authority/task resolution is deferred to later work.
known_limitations: No dedicated authority approval store exists yet.
Crash reconciliation, lease renewal/fencing and task lifecycle remain S1-WP2 or later.
Command execution is not an OS sandbox.
No quarantine relocation is performed for invalid workspaces; failure is explicit and non-destructive.

evidence.finding: Normal ensure is validation/reuse; destructive reset requires explicit flag.
Authority fields are required, bound to the registered worktree/action, and included in durable audit payloads.
Execution authority fields are part of the request envelope.
Authority is propagated from durable event/request envelopes; privileged authority is not synthesized.
Existing gateway regression updated for explicit authority.
Existing enforcement chamber passes with explicit authority.
42 tests pass in the complete unittest discovery run.
